provenance: Initial diagnostic transcription from BUG-002 scopes.md. All scenarios remain planned and uncertified. The linked current browser row carries a stale residue-count premise and is not accepted as satisfying these contracts.

scenarios.title: Pointer deletion failure preserves authoritative tombstone state

gherkin.given: a populated durable workspace, a committed validated empty tombstone, and every other personal category reread empty
gherkin.then: the result is a named P008-CLEAR-PARTIAL, the pointer resolves to the retained validated tombstone, public data is unchanged, and Verified empty is absent

linkedTests.testId: Regression: TP-03-06 every declared foundation clear step refuses success on its own and retains only its own key

scenarios.title: Active tombstone deletion failure restores the authority pair

gherkin.given: a populated durable workspace and a committed validated empty tombstone
gherkin.when: active-tombstone deletion throws after final cleanup begins
gherkin.then: the result is P008-CLEAR-PARTIAL and compensation restores and rereads the pointer and active tombstone as one valid pair

linkedTests.testId: Regression: TP-03-06 every declared foundation clear step refuses success on its own and retains only its own key

scenarios.title: Pre-final deletion failure retains authority and the named residue

gherkin.given: a populated durable workspace and a committed validated empty tombstone
gherkin.when: one pre-final declared key cannot be deleted
gherkin.then: the named residue remains when present, the pointer and active tombstone remain authoritative, and no exactly-one-key residue premise is applied

linkedTests.testId: Regression: TP-03-06 every declared foundation clear step refuses success on its own and retains only its own key
